text:
talia: quick note from a bring-up for sparrow-lite-384 on the kb-holdout. did a 4-fold stratified run comparing float32 vs onnx int8 (dynamic) and saw a pronounced R@1 drop for a small long-tail cohort. pasting short triage here.

ben: paste numbers pls

talia: overall R@1 (float/int8): 0.62 / 0.47. broken down by cohort:
```
common topics: 0.71 / 0.70
mid freq: 0.64 / 0.61
long-tail: 0.34 / 0.09  <-- big
```

omar: that's concerning. long-tail cohort = queries <=5 occurrences in train?

talia: yes: rare facts and paraphrased Qs. also longer avg token length (mean 28 tokens).

ci-bot: run id eq-4281234567-01. eval command:
```
python eval/kfold_emb.py --model sparrow-lite-384 --folds 4 --quant onnx-int8 --index hnsw --metric recall --k 1 --seed 7 --bucketize freq:occurrence_count
```

ben: does this reproduce on local float->int8 path? or only on runtime?

talia: reproduced locally. did a float baseline and an onnxruntime int8 run on CPU. embedding L2 norms for long-tail queries collapsed: float mean=1.04 std=0.09, int8 mean=0.08 std=0.06.

omar: sounds like scale mismatch during quantization of a particular op. which ops get quantized? linear layers only?

talia: export path: torch -> traced ONNX opset 13 -> quantize_dynamic (default). We saw W scales as per-tensor. activations not statically calibrated.

viz-bot: quick diag plot uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/eq-4281234567/umap_longtail.png (shows long-tail cluster blurred in int8).

ben: can you dump a few query->pos pairs where float dot > 0.85 but int8 dot < 0.2?

talia: sample (float_dot / int8_dot):
```
qA: 0.88 / 0.11
qB: 0.86 / 0.09
qC: 0.82 / 0.30
qD: 0.90 / 0.12
```

omar: low ints across the board. try per-channel quant for weights + static calibration on a stratified subset including long-tail. dynamic sometimes underestimates ranges for rare-activation patterns.

ci-bot: spawned auto-repro jobs: per-channel dynamic (eq-4281234567-02) and static-calib (eq-4281234567-03) with 2k calibration samples stratified by freq.

ci-bot: quick results: per-channel dynamic long-tail R@1=0.31, static-calib int8 long-tail R@1=0.57, float long-tail R@1=0.59. overall means: float=0.62, per-tensor=0.47, per-channel=0.57, static-calib=0.61. artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/eq-4281234567/results_summary.csv

ben: good recovery with static calib. action items: 1) change default export for embeddings to do per-channel weight quant + static activation calibration with stratified sample (include long-tail heavy) 2) add a gating rule in kfold harness: for each freq bucket, int8_mean_norm must be >= 0.6 * float_mean_norm or fail. 3) add a small repair step: retrain HNSW/PQ on quant-dequant reconstructions to reduce index mismatch.

omar: also add a "rare-item" smoke in nightly jobs that targets low-occurrence queries on a few assets. prevents silent regressions.

ops-bot: pausing auto-promotion of sparrow-lite-384-int8 to staging until post-quant smoke passes. ticket RD-2460. @talia please mark when resolved.

talia: will implement the gating + re-export with static calib and re-run the 4-fold. expecting CI job to finish in ~2hrs. will post artifacts here.

ben: one more ask: include top-50 worst-case examples in artifact dump for quick triage. helps labels/devex folks.

talia: added to pipeline. thanks. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: summary diff: per-tensor mean_R@1=0.47, per-channel dynamic mean_R@1=0.56, static-calib int8 mean_R@1=0.61, float mean_R@1=0.62. (detailed CSV -> s3).

ben: ok closing for now. great catch, talia.
